response.sql: WITH per_op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_gb_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), valid AS (SELECT * FROM per_op WHERE avg_gb_min IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_min) AS overall_avg FROM valid) SELECT AVG(n_scans) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_gb_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_min - overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM valid, overall WHERE avg_gb_min > overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: An operator's scan count is the number of all their rows in scans (COUNT(*)), including rows where gbsize or spanmin is missing.

A scan with spanmin of 0 is treated as missing (division yields NULL) and is ignored in the GB-per-minute average. Operators with no valid ratio are excluded from the all-operator average and from the result.
The all-operator average is the simple, unweighted mean of the per-operator average GB per minute values.

alternatives.interpretation: Scan count only includes scans that have a valid GB-per-minute value (gbsize and nonzero spanmin both present), so 'ignore missing values' applies to the count as well.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_op AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS n_scans, AVG(gbsize * 1.0 / spanmin) AS avg_gb_min FROM scans WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY crewref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_min) AS overall_avg FROM per_op) SELECT AVG(n_scans) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_gb_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_min - overall_avg) AS avg_margin_above_overall FROM per_op, overall WHERE avg_gb_min > overall_avg
